name: Amama
note: Handcrafted statement accessories with a playful, colourful feel. The bags here are its bestselling ones.

name: AMPM
note: A homegrown designer house, picked for its occasion clutches and wristlets with intricate handwork.

name: Banjaaran Studio
note: Handcrafted footwear made fully in-house. Known for its bomber sneakers, which put an Indian twist on a sneaker.

name: Ceecee
note: Distinctive, fun shoe designs with personality, from mules to boots, at a slightly premium price.

name: Chal Shoes
note: Modern takes on traditional Indian mules and mojaris, in fabrics like satin and denim.

name: Daang
note: Easy, comfortable everyday shoes: flats, sandals, slip-ons and boots, in leather and suede.

name: Disobedience
note: Handmade by artisans, with plant-based and vegan leathers and bold, sculptural heels.

name: Drawn
note: Wearable art for everyday life: flowing, feminine dresses with artistic prints and ruffles.

name: July Issue
note: Playful, statement co-ords and dresses for parties and occasions.

name: Khara Kapas
note: Handcrafted Indian cotton clothing with prints from original watercolour paintings.

name: Kilchu
note: A contemporary Indian label with handmade leather bags, artisanal footwear and handwoven garments, made with skilled artisans across India. Known for its Tabi heels.

name: Mai Soli
note: Genuine leather and quality craft, from in-house tanning to the final stitch.

name: Mistry
note: Handcrafted leather accessories and footwear in suede and fun textures.

name: Nappa Dori
note: Handcrafted leather goods that blend Indian heritage with minimalist design. Great for travel.

name: Slomotion
note: Understated, comfortable sandals, slides and mule loafers with clean lines.

name: Tanned
note: Homegrown, handcrafted leather bags and accessories, including statement metallic finishes.

name: The Jodi Life
note: Sustainable fashion rooted in Indian tradition and design, with handloom and jamdani pieces.

name: The Summer House
note: Handwoven and handloom clothes in natural fabrics, made for small occasions like dinners and art evenings.

name: Tiger Marron
note: Handmade leather bags in contemporary designs, including vegan leather options.

name: Tin & Tah (Tintah)
note: Hand-crafted, artsy bags that look more like wearable art than accessories.

name: Verb by Pallavi Singhee
note: Embroidered kaftans, co-ords and dresses in premium fabrics, with timeless Indian artistry.
